title: Aftermath 4
description: This a datapack that adds new features to your game, like crafts and some structures!
body:
A simple datapack me and friends use to play on our private server, it includes:
```
4 new copper structures
```

```
crafts for:trident, bottle of dragons breath, sceleton and creeper heads, trial keys and elytras
```

```
3 advancements
```
```
and a beta\alpha new biome
```
